title: RAYmi by the Pool's new single "RAYmiverse" where vibes meet AI-infused funk
htmlContent: RAYmi by the Pool is entering a parallel universe with his first-ever single, “RAYmiverse.” Intended as the launching pad of an open-ended series of weekly releases, RAYmiverse is an overture to what this feline-fronted, AI-driven cosmos is all about: groove, whimsy, and a leering look forward at what music can be. RAYmiverse is a party disguise for here’s what Ray would write if he ever bothered to think such things. His wordplay is on some meme-worthy shit, and it sounds not only futuristic but also mind-stretching. The chorus enters overdrive mode, smashing together house-lite 808s and crunchy, funky guitar riffs, as well as a polyphonic symphony of glitchy AI-coded chants that pay off like the moment everything explodes at an EDM festival. It’s shout-back music, built to be shouted back at the stage or screen with hands raised high. https://open.spotify.com/track/1aUucWBApbr0oRb6U9vtZF?si=81a8d0c0b737477a But RAYmi is a character, a side cat incarnate of the pool deck in AI dance videos that are already going viral on TikTok. To watch him groove, cat swagger, and all to his own surreal funk bangers, it's as if you're witnessing one-third art project, one-third parody, and one-third bona fide party starter. The RAYmiverse has an open-door policy. RAY mi promises to blow this world out still further each week with a new AI-generated track that lets as many ripples between algorithmic play and, goddammit, some actual fucking groove. The result? It’s a meowtastic cool zone where meme culture rendezvouses with futuristic beats, and everyone is encouraged to dive right in.
